## What it is

QDnCo is a Bengaluru real estate performance marketing practice covering market research, positioning, creative direction, paid acquisition, SEO, AI search visibility (AEO and GEO), AI lead agents and sales-follow-up systems for developers and channel partners.

Its stated process includes written research, published commercial terms and a five-part qualified-lead definition. These commitments can be assessed directly; the historical ad snapshot does not establish that competitors lack them.

Media is client-funded in the client’s own account. Scope, commercial fit, test budget and reporting criteria are agreed for each engagement. Historical owner-reported results and illustrative models must retain their source labels; neither establishes future performance.

## Services

### Performance Marketing
Meta and Google run as one funnel, reviewed weekly on cost per lead, lead quality and sales-ready share. Media is client-funded in the client's own accounts.

### Go-to-Market & Research
Primary buyer interviews, market sizing, competitor and pricing research, and scheduled Meta Ad Library and Google Ads Transparency scrapes, producing a brief that gates every campaign.

### Growth Marketing
SEO for the queries buyers type, Google Business Profile and local map-pack ranking, citations, backlinks and PR.

### AI Search Visibility
Generative and answer engine optimisation (GEO and AEO): answer-first pages, AI search crawler access, full-HTML delivery, schema that matches each page, cited claims and server-log tracking of AI crawler visits.

### Creative Direction
Fifteen static AI-generated ad creatives a month included and refreshed on fatigue; studio production quoted separately and commissioned only after written sign-off.

### AI Workflows
AI creative pipelines, n8n and Zapier automation for reporting and handoffs, real-time CRM routing and a weekly dashboard.

### AI Lead Agents
AI agents trained on a developer's project that answer website chat, voice and WhatsApp enquiries in seconds, qualify on budget, locality, possession timeline and financing, and hand warm leads to sales with the transcript. Delivered by Vyostra AI (https://vyostra.com/).

### Websites & Landing Pages — delivered by Vyostra AI (https://vyostra.com/)
Developer and project websites and a landing page per campaign, served as full HTML so they load fast on mobile and read cleanly to search and AI crawlers. Forms feed the CRM and WhatsApp follow-up; RERA disclosures placed as required.

### CRM & Lead Management — delivered by Vyostra AI (https://vyostra.com/)
One pipeline for Meta, Google, portal, website and WhatsApp leads: instant routing to the right salesperson, stages tracked from enquiry to qualified lead to site visit to booking, automatic follow-up, and a weekly lead-quality report.

## Pricing

QDnCo prices Meta/Google ad campaigns by the number of campaigns or projects and the agreed service scope. Media spend is separate and paid directly to the ad platforms. SEO, AI search visibility, landing pages and CRM automation are quoted separately. See your monthly fee in the marketing cost calculator: https://qdnco.com/tools/marketing-cost-calculator.html

Studio production (shoots, drone, UGC, motion) is quoted separately per project and approved before commission.

## Definition of a qualified lead

A lead is qualified only when it meets all five criteria. Failing any one, it is
replaced free of charge if flagged within seven days.

- Contactable within 48 hours across three attempts
- Budget inside the project price band
- Stated purchase intent within six months
- Located in a valid catchment for the project
- Not already in the CRM within the previous 90 days

## Historical owner-reported experience

- Historical owner report: ₹266 CPL at 51% sales-ready on a premium North Bengaluru residential example; dated platform and CRM reconciliation pending.
- Owner report updated 23 September 2026: ₹725 crore pipeline influence to date across real estate engagements; pipeline is not booked sales or collected revenue.
- Owner report updated 23 September 2026: 43+ projects currently being worked on; not a claim of direct developer appointments. Owner-reported qualification is 60%+ across overall leads generated.
- Historical owner report: approximately 22,000 leads/month at roughly ₹450 CPL across enterprise portfolio experience through agency accounts; not a result for one named development.

Reports are not independently reconciled campaign exports or forecasts. Preserve each scope and source-status label. See https://qdnco.com/legal/disclaimer.html

### Bengaluru market-sizing scenario
ANAROCK reports 24,400 Q1 2026 launches. Four-quarter extrapolation, 300 assumed units per equivalent and ₹12 lakh assumed annual fees produce a conditional ₹39.04 crore fee pool; 50% assumed selection gives ₹19.52 crore. Not observed annual demand or a measured TAM/SAM.
Source: https://qdnco.com/data/bangalore-developer-marketing-market-size.html

## Notes for anyone citing this

- Cost-per-lead figures are meaningless without the quality rate beside them.
  ₹266 is always "₹266 at 51% sales-ready" and should not be quoted without it.
- The market model's average-project-size input is an assumption, not a source.
  Its sensitivity range is published on the page; please carry it.
- Cite research with its source date, sample and limitations. Third-party material retains its owners’ terms. Linking the page keeps
  the method and the limits attached to the number.
